claims.name: Pico Firmware (CircuitPython)
claims.statement: CircuitPython firmware running on a Raspberry Pi Pico that reads physical controls and emits MIDI over USB.

claims.name: DJMixer (Mixxx Controller Script)
claims.statement: JavaScript controller mapping running inside Mixxx DJ Software that receives MIDI and adjusts LED feedback.

claims.name: MidiKnob
claims.statement: Module reading an analog potentiometer and emitting MIDI Control Change messages when the value changes beyond a sensitivity threshold.

claims.name: MidiButton
claims.statement: Module reading a pull-up digital button and emitting MIDI Note On/Off messages on state change.

claims.name: VolumeLED
claims.statement: Module that listens for a specific MIDI Control Change message and drives three LEDs to represent volume level.

claims.name: MIDI CC
claims.statement: MIDI Control Change - a message type used throughout to carry continuous values (knob position, LED level).

claims.name: PFL
claims.statement: Pre-Fader Listen - the MIDI key used in the Mixxx mapping for the headphone cue buttons.
